newsitem.title: USA: KLA, Tencor see Q4 merger charge.
newsitem.headline: KLA, Tencor see Q4 merger charge.

text.p: KLA Instruments and Tencor Instruments said Wednesday that shareholders of both companies have approved their merger, and said they expect a one-time merger charge of about $40 million.
The charge will be recorded in the fourth quarter and will cover direct merger transaction costs, integration costs and other merger-related expenses, the companies said in a joint release.

The companies announced their intention to merge in January. The combined entity, KLA-Tencor Corp, is expected to have combined revenues of more than $1 billion and will be a powerhouse in the market for semiconductor capital equipment used for monitoring production and improving yeilds.
